rules.statement: A husband is not the 'duly authorized agent' of his wife merely by being her husband, and a receipt given by him for rent to which she is solely entitled does not discharge the obligation to pay rent.
rules.supporting_quote: "There are circumstances in which a husband may be regarded as the agent of his wife by implication. But he is not so merely by reason of the fact that he is the husband and the fact that the third defendant joined in the lease did not under the circumstances make him a 'duly authorized agent' of the plaintiff to give receipts for money to which she is solely entitled."
